description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: A security remediation gate is required for modernization readiness and safer cloud deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities before deployment. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions; if a major-version upgrade is required, document dependency, current version, upgraded version, and breaking-change risk. Verify the project build and existing tests after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Use the existing .NET Framework 4.8 application environment and build flow established in this repository.

tasks.description: Deploy the application to Azure Container Apps for cloud hosting.
tasks.reason: The modernization goal is to move the application to Azure using a managed deployment target.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using existing Azure resources and managed identity-oriented deployment practices.
